_doc: evolve-demo: a tiny claudecode-domain suite (4 evolve tasks + 1 heldout task). Each evaluation = 4 evolve tasks x k=2 = 8 headless Claude Code sessions on the frozen policy ("inherit": the model you use, pinned per run directory); each round draws m=2 candidates, drafts each in its own git worktree, screens them with a leakage critic, evaluates the survivors and keeps the best admissible one (Algorithm 1 + Algorithm 2 of google-research/rrsi). delta=0.125 = one trial of the 8 per evaluation (RRSI's coding config fixes delta the same way, as passes: 3 of 178). With k=2 and agreeing trials the bootstrap estimate (delta=null) is 0, which would admit a single lucky trial; set delta=null only with k>=3 or several base evaluations (`rrsi-evolve calibrate --jobs base,base2`). Model names: inherit (default), haiku/sonnet/opus or a full id; the costs quoted in the README were measured with haiku everywhere.
